title: RouteFlow: replication package for "Dependency-Aware Task Decomposition and Parallel Multi-LLM Execution on Serverless Workflows"
description: Replication package for a paper under double-blind review. It contains the code, per-task run records and analysis outputs for the four configurations evaluated in the paper (B0, A1, P-DeepSeek, P-Sonnet) on 100 LongCoT chemistry tasks. python replication/verify.py regenerates the archived performance, cost and accuracy summaries from the shipped records (Python 3.14, standard library only, a few seconds). Historical dataset-validation and development/reserve coverage reports are included separately, and replication/CLAIMS.md maps claims to analysis outputs, reports or external sources. Instructions for re-grading and re-execution are in replication/README.md. AWS account identifiers are redacted. LongCoT-derived data remains under LongCoT's MIT License; please do not use it for model training.
